sheet.name: Paleblood Worms

traits.name: Bloodrush
traits.text: Start of Clash: Each Knight places 5 Blood [Blood] tokens on their Knight Board. If at any point there are more than 5 Blood [Blood] tokens on your Knight Board, immediately discard all excess tokens. If at any point there are no Blood [Blood] tokens on your Knight Board, you bleed out (you die) unless you are Incarnated.

traits.name: It Sucks!
traits.text:
Suck X: Move X Blood [Blood] tokens from the Target or the Attacker onto this Paleblood Worm’s BP card.
[Blood gate] Gates on AI and BP cards refer to the number of Blood [Blood] tokens on the corresponding Mob.

traits.name: Bloodbath
traits.text:
Whenever a Paleblood Worm with Blood [Blood] tokens dies, distribute the tokens among Knights in Zone X, where X is the amount of those tokens. If there are no eligible Targets in the Zone, discard those tokens.

During Escalation, if there are no more cards in the Escalation decks, place a Blood [Blood] token on every card on the Mob track instead.

traits.name: Subterranean Menace
traits.text:
When a Paleblood Worm dies, finish resolving the current action, then Spawn a new Paleblood Worm outside the Clash Board.

When a Paleblood Worm outside the Clash Board is about to activate, place it on the Paleburrow Terrain tile closest to the [Priority Target] Priority Target.

Burrow X: Place the Paleblood Worm on the designated Paleburrow tile, where X is the number shown on that tile.

traits.name: Red Soil
traits.text: Whenever you discard a Blood [Blood] token, place it on this Trait instead. After you finish the current action, if there are 3 or more tokens on this Trait, remove all tokens from this Trait and Activate 1 for every 3 tokens discarded this way.

traits.name: Scab Armor
traits.text:
Start of Clash: Place a Blood [Blood] token on every BP card on the Mob track.

Paleblood Worms Spawn with a Blood [Blood] token on them.

Each Paleblood Worm gains +1 [AT] for every Blood [Blood] token on its BP card.

traits.name: Bloodline
traits.text: When you trigger the Bloodbath Trait, first check if there is another Paleblood Worm in the Zone. If there is, move all Blood [Blood] tokes onto that Paleblood Worm instead.

_notes.gates: Red-drop arrow tags are Blood gates (number of Blood tokens on the corresponding Mob, per the It Sucks! trait). gate.text/effect = printed tag text; gate.where = moveTag | targeting | effect:i | afterAttack (also used for AFTER FINAL ATTACK) | wound | fail (BP). One gate (Paint the Swamp Red moveTag) is stored with lte instead of gte.
_notes.reactWindows: AI: 'targeting' = REACT! on the rule under the targeting block; 'effect:i' = REACT! on the rule under effects[i]. No BP card in this deck shows a REACT! marker.
_notes.cornerGlyph: Every card shows an ornate 'P' in the top-left crest; level comes from the footer.
_notes.codes: AI codes 27A1378–27A1389, BP codes 28A1755–28A1766, read from tiny pale print (5x zoom) and consistent with a contiguous run; individual last digits are uncertain where noted.
